logo_override.validation_detail: svg 200 image/svg+xml, 16764 bytes; full colour KAUST mark (tree fills #F3901D/#EEB111/#C1CD23/#00B1B0, wordmark #6F6259) - not white-on-transparent
logo_override._award: Header navbar-brand logo (a.navbar-brand > img, alt="KAUST", 247x91) present in the shared Sitefinity layout of both / and /fees-funding; served from the host's own site-branding library at /images/default-source/interface/site-branding/.

notes: Scanned homepage and /fees-funding markup for logo-bearing img, og:image, msapplication-TileImage and schema.org logo. Two logo assets exist on this host: (1) /images/default-source/interface/site-branding/KAUST_Logo.svg - the full-colour primary logo used in the white header navbar on every page; (2) /images/default-source/interface/site-branding/kaust_logo_white.svg - REJECTED, it is a white-on-transparent wordmark for the dark footer, which is a hard ban. Chose (1). Probed via webfetch (returned valid SVG markup, Adobe Illustrator export, viewBox 0 0 546.5 201.3 - no HTML in place of image bytes) and confirmed by HEAD request: STATUS=200, Content-Type=image/svg+xml, Content-Length=16764. Fill colours are the official KAUST palette (orange/yellow/green/teal tree + dark-brown #6F6259 lettering), so it renders correctly on a white background. Host evidence: admissions.kaust.edu.sa is a subdomain of the shard host's own registrable domain kaust.edu.sa, and the asset path is relative-rooted on the same host - no third-party CDN. Also probed /assets/images/favicon/favicon-32x32.png (image fetched successfully, renders as the KAUST tree) and the msapplication-TileImage /assets/images/favicon/ms-icon-144x144.png reference; both are icons rather than the official wordmark logo, so the SVG lockup is the correct pick. og:image on /fees-funding points to funding-banner.webp, a page banner, not a logo, and was rejected. No other files modified.
